instruction: An arctic seascape at night: drifting ice floes on dark water, sculpted icebergs with blue undersides, a polar bear and cub on the largest floe, a distant igloo with a warm glow, seals near a breathing hole, gently animated aurora curtains in green and violet overhead, and stars reflecting between the ice sheets.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Arctic Ice Floe Night. An arctic seascape at night: drifting ice floes on dark water, sculpted icebergs with blue undersides, a polar bear and cub on the largest floe, a distant igloo with a warm glow, seals near a breathing hole, gently animated aurora curtains in green and violet overhead, and stars reflecting between the ice sheets. Style: polar minimal realism. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
